title: InfraWorks workflows and connector status
description: Explore InfraWorks workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.
html:
SoftwareUpcoming

Autodesk

InfraWorks

InfraWorks supports contextual infrastructure planning, concept design and stakeholder communication.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a contextual model

Use the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended InfraWorks preview, build a contextual model; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Compare route concepts

Start from the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended InfraWorks preview, compare route concepts; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Present an infrastructure proposal

Begin with the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended InfraWorks preview, present an infrastructure proposal; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
